strategy.overview: Tent modes, persistent steins, two lock Multiballs, Food Stand, and playfield multipliers can strengthen one another. Prepare two Corkscrew locks, begin a compatible Tent mode, then take the third lock and work its shots alongside the moving Multiball jackpots.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete TENT and shoot the scoop to choose a Tent mode. Complete OKTOBERFEST and lock two balls on the lowered Coaster ramp, start a compatible Tent, then take the third lock to add Corkscrew Multiball.
strategy.summary: Collect a useful stein, prepare two Corkscrew locks, and complete TENT. Start a compatible Tent mode at the scoop, then take the third Coaster lock. During Multiball, follow the mode shots and red jackpots before returning to the Coaster ramp for the Super.

quickInfo.name: Tent modes
quickInfo.summary: Complete TENT through the return lanes and scoop progress, shoot the Tent scoop, and use the flippers to choose an available mode.

quickInfo.name: Corkscrew Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete the OKTOBER and FEST banks, then collect three locks on the lowered left Coaster ramp.

quickInfo.name: Beer Barrel Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete PROST to light a lock, then use the upper flipper to shoot the side ramp; repeat for three locks.

quickInfo.name: Beer steins
quickInfo.summary: Hit the Bar door until it opens, then shoot inside to choose a permanent benefit. A linked stein also multiplies its Tent mode's scoring.

quickInfo.name: Food Stand
quickInfo.summary: Hit the center drop and spinner until Food lights, then shoot the center scoop during single-ball play.

steps.text: Hit the Bar door until it opens, then shoot inside. Choose a stein that improves the Tent mode or lock route you intend to play.
Complete the OKTOBER and FEST target banks, then shoot the lowered Coaster ramp twice to hold two Corkscrew locks.
Complete TENT in the return lanes or through scoop progress. Shoot the Tent scoop and use the flippers to choose a compatible mode; do not choose Looper for the Corkscrew stack.
After the Tent begins, shoot the Coaster ramp for the third lock and start Corkscrew Multiball.
Collect the red Multiball jackpots while making the active Tent shots. Complete OKTOBER or FEST again, then shoot the Coaster ramp when the Super Jackpot lights.
Use the top lanes and available MagNabs to raise or extend the playfield multiplier when that route does not pull you away from a ready Super.

fallback.title: Beer Barrel route
fallback.when: Use this when the Coaster ramp rejects but PROST and the upper-flipper side ramp are feeding cleanly.

steps.text: Complete PROST to light a Beer Barrel lock.
Use the upper flipper to shoot the side ramp and lock a ball; repeat the PROST-to-ramp sequence for three locks.
During Beer Barrel Multiball, collect the lit jackpots and relock a ball in the Barrel to multiply the following jackpots.

alternatives.title: Food preparation
alternatives.when: Use this between Multiballs when the center drop, spinner, and Food Stand scoop are controllable.

steps.text: Build the next Food mode at the center drop and spinner, then start it at the center scoop during single-ball play.
Collect its calories before starting the next Multiball; calories are fixed when that Multiball begins.
After Food is active, add a Tent mode or prepared Multiball when the game leaves those starts available.
Complete all thirteen Tent modes to reach Flipper Miestro.
Collect every different stein to reach Stein Slinging.
Keep using the persistent stein benefits and built Food values while working the remaining festival features.

techniques.name: Flipper staging
techniques.instruction: Partially press the right flipper button when the switch permits it so the lower flipper can stay controlled while the upper flipper takes the Beer Barrel ramp.

cautions.issue: Looper lowers the Coaster ramp for its own mode and does not stack with Corkscrew Multiball.
cautions.response: Choose a different Tent mode before taking the third Corkscrew lock.
